findings.summary: Spec Required behavior #5 is undelivered: nothing in the repo points readers to quota-api `:8101/api/quotas`. The only added prose is the private migration's doc comment, which says lingzhi quota has a single exit at quota-api but never names the concrete endpoint, and a doc comment on a private schema function is not reachable by the audience the spec names ("避免后来者以为功能丢失"). No entry was added under docs/, and no user-facing surface carries the breadcrumb. This is an explicitly numbered Required behavior with a one-line fix, so the change is not complete.

The idempotency assertion is vacuous. By the time the second `apply_schema_migrations_on_conn` runs, user_version is already 12, so the loop body never dispatches `migrate_v11_to_v12` a second time and the assert compares a value against itself. `migrate_v11_to_v12` is in fact idempotent by construction (it only rewrites when enabled == true), but the spec's verification bullet "migration 幂等：连续执行两次不报错、结果一致" is not actually exercised. Calling `Database::migrate_v11_to_v12(&conn)` directly twice, or resetting user_version to 11 before the second apply, would test what the assertion claims to test.

The spec's premise does not match the dispatched base. `src-tauri/src/proxy/quota.rs`, `billing_unit()`, and a `/quota` route do not exist anywhere at the reviewed commit — the proxy route table has no /quota, and the sole consumer of `has_usage_script_enabled()` is the tray menu (tray.rs:249 and tray.rs:828). The spec targets branch `feat/quota-endpoint`, but target_base_commit 99baf154 lacks that endpoint. The migration still retires the unit at the data layer, which the spec designates as the 优先做法 requiring no logic change, so this is not an implementation defect; but it does make the spec's two `billing_unit()` unit-test bullets unsatisfiable, and the Implementer silently substituted DB-level tests without recording that the required tests could not be written. It also means the in-repo behavioral effect is removal of the lingzhi tray usage suffix, not removal of a /quota billing unit.

The repo carries no test-run evidence for this change: .dd-evidence/acceptance.json records a cargo test run whose cwd belongs to a different development (dev_ccswitch_lingzhi_claude_provider_03), so it is stale relative to this attempt. Static inspection shows the new code should compile — `create_tables_on_conn`, `apply_schema_migrations_on_conn`, `get_user_version`, `set_user_version`, and `has_column` are all pub(crate) on Database, SCHEMA_VERSION is bumped to 12 in database/mod.rs:52, and tests.rs already imports json!/params!/Connection — but as a read-only reviewer I could not execute the suite and no in-repo artifact attests that it passes.

Spec Required behavior #4 (removing LINGZHI_ACCESS_TOKEN from /data/cc-switch/cc-switch.env while keeping LINGZHI_API_KEY) targets a runtime file outside this repository and cannot be discharged by a code commit; it remains a deployment step verified by the spec's live-system grep. Agreeing with the Continuous reviewer on this point, it is not counted against the Implementer.

The parts that were delivered are sound and I found no correctness defect in them. migrate_v11_to_v12 mirrors the established v5->v6 meta-rewrite idiom (schema.rs:1042-1089), guards on has_column before reading meta, matches the real serde key path (ProviderMeta.usage_script has no rename and UsageScript.enabled is a plain bool, provider.rs:80-101), filters strictly on id.eq_ignore_ascii_case("lingzhi") so codex OAuth and every other provider are untouched, and cannot hit a NULL meta because the column is declared TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'. No inference-forwarding path, LINGZHI_API_KEY handling, proxy_request_logs, usage_daily_rollups, or the lingzhi providers row was modified, so every "Do not change" item is respected.
